Mechanisms.Features: Two contiguous completed M15 cash-open bars 01:30–02:00 UTC, same date with high/low and mean candle range; latest completed signal M15 bar within session, no intrabar hindsight or lookahead.
Mechanisms.Signal: Latest completed M15 high >= first-half-hour high +0.10*mean open M15 range and closes strictly inside first-half-hour high/low with bearish body => SHORT. Mirror low <= opening low-0.10*mean open range and bullish body => LONG. Tick volume latest >=0.7*open mean; last bar range>0; real spread <=0.35*last bar range.
Mechanisms.Driver: Normalized rejected overshoot beyond opening high/low / latest close
